<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>write-product-content</code></p>

Write concrete reader-facing product content from verified evidence without private leakage or internal process narration.

## When to use

Write or revise reader-facing product documentation, release text, README copy, UI copy, or technical explanations using concrete evidence and no internal process narration.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link write-product-content --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link write-product-content --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Learning outcomes

- Turn authoritative product facts into concise audience-directed content.
- Remove unsupported claims, generic filler, repetition, and private context leakage.

## Examples

### Rewrite product documentation

**Prompt**

> Use the write-product-content skill to revise this documentation for developers while preserving its approved structure and presentation.

**Expected outcome**

The content leads with developer outcomes, uses verified commands, and removes process-centered filler.

### Prepare concise release copy

**Prompt**

> Use the write-product-content skill to turn these verified release facts into concise consumer-facing copy.

**Expected outcome**

The release text states concrete user impact without commit narration or unsupported significance.
